notes.en: The `default` variant uses the defaults of both packages. The current package intentionally ships a different default slugify than the reference legacy percent-encoding slugify: it lowercases ASCII, keeps non-ASCII characters (e.g. CJK), folds whitespace and dashes into a single dash and strips other ASCII punctuation. Headings with punctuation, CJK or raw HTML text therefore produce different ids; those cases carry a `note`. Generated ids are compared byte for byte and are never normalized.
notes.zh: `default` 变体使用两个包的默认配置。当前包有意提供与参考包旧版百分号编码 slugify 不同的默认 slugify：它将 ASCII 转为小写，保留非 ASCII 字符（如 CJK），把空白和连字符折叠为单个连字符，并去除其他 ASCII 标点。因此，含标点、CJK 或原始 HTML 文本的标题会产生不同的 id；这些用例带有 `note`。生成的 id 按字节比较，从不归一化。

notes.en: The `legacy-slugify` variant configures the current package with its exported `legacySlugify`, which is byte-identical to the reference default slugify, so every heading id matches.
notes.zh: `legacy-slugify` 变体为当前包配置其导出的 `legacySlugify`，它与参考包的默认 slugify 逐字节相同，因此所有标题 id 都一致。

notes.en: `link-inside-header` compares the `linkInsideHeader` permalink presets with the same `class` and `symbol` options and a matching slugify. Markup is identical except for the empty-slug placeholder difference.
notes.zh: `link-inside-header` 使用相同的 `class`、`symbol` 选项和匹配的 slugify 比较 `linkInsideHeader` 永久链接预设。除空 slug 占位符差异外，标记完全相同。

notes.en: `header-link` compares the `headerLink` presets. The current preset leaves headings that already contain a link untouched, because wrapping them would emit invalid nested `<a>` elements, while the reference wraps the existing link; that case carries a `note`.
notes.zh: `header-link` 比较 `headerLink` 预设。当前预设不会改动已包含链接的标题，因为再包裹会产生无效的嵌套 `<a>` 元素；参考包则会包裹已有链接。该用例带有 `note`。

notes.en: Empty slugs are behavior, not a formatting difference: for headings without text (image-only or empty headings) the reference emits `id=""`, while the current package falls back to its `defaultPlaceHolder` option (`heading`). These cases carry a `note`.
notes.zh: 空 slug 属于行为差异而非格式差异：对于没有文本的标题（仅图片或空标题），参考包输出 `id=""`，当前包则回退到其 `defaultPlaceHolder` 选项（`heading`）。这些用例带有 `note`。

notes.en: Manual heading ids (e.g. set by plugin-attrs) are not compared: both packages reuse a preset id and both throw on duplicate explicit ids (reference default `failOnNonUnique: true`; the current package has no option to disable the failure).
notes.zh: 不比较手动设置的标题 id（例如由 plugin-attrs 设置）：两个包都会复用预设 id，且遇到重复的显式 id 都会抛错（参考包默认 `failOnNonUnique: true`；当前包没有可关闭该失败的选项）。

notes.en: Scaling: `duplicate-headings` is quadratic in the reference, because its unique-slug loop rescans the used-slug map for every duplicate; the current package resumes from the last used candidate and stays linear. `unique-headings` exposes the leftover `state.tokens.indexOf(token)` call the reference executes for every heading after the permalink step (the O(n²) loop from markdown-it-anchor#80); the current package only rescans when a permalink actually moves the heading token. `heading-inline-content` is the linear baseline.
notes.zh: 扩展性：`duplicate-headings` 在参考包中呈二次增长，因为其唯一 slug 循环会为每个重复项重新扫描已用 slug 映射；当前包从最后使用的候选项继续，保持线性。`unique-headings` 暴露了参考包在永久链接步骤后为每个标题执行的 `state.tokens.indexOf(token)` 调用（即 markdown-it-anchor#80 中的 O(n²) 循环）；当前包仅在永久链接实际移动标题 token 时才重新扫描。`heading-inline-content` 是线性基线。

notes.en: Benchmarks render fixed corpora (`normal` = sparse headings, `heavy` = heading-dense) and compare both sides interleaved; the ratio and exponent values in the result file come from the controlled sequential comparison run, not from ad-hoc runs.
notes.zh: 基准测试渲染固定语料（`normal` = 稀疏标题，`heavy` = 标题密集），并交错比较双方；结果文件中的比率和指数值来自受控的顺序对比运行，而不是临时运行。

notes.en: Only attribute order is normalized (the harness default); no other normalization is applied.
notes.zh: 仅归一化属性顺序（测试框架默认行为）；不应用其他归一化。
